slice: RPP-5kc selected geometry-changing MLINE 340 retarget with offset reprojection
scope: Adds a fail-closed AC1027 ordinary MLINE route for changing group 340 to a source-bound target MLINESTYLE whose geometry differs from the original style only by supported offsets. Reprojects the selected uncut MLINE group-41 parameters using the target offsets. This is selected output/geometry evidence, not native CAD semantic qualification or whole-document support.

references.use: Group 340 identifies the MLINESTYLE object; group 2 is redundant; group 41 stores the segment parameter used with the miter vector.
Group 49 carries each MLINESTYLE element offset; flag 2 selects the miter-display profile used here.

contract.admission: Both original and target style bodies must be source-bound, complete, and pass existing dictionary/provider checks. They must have known matching geometry flags (the selected projector further requires flags 2), equal start/end angles, and equal element count; the consumer count must match. Style colors, linetypes, description and other non-geometry metadata may differ and remain governed by the target style body. Target geometry change outside supported offset differences refuses. Every affected original/live consumer must remain source-joined and pass the selected retarget planner; unrelated deleted consumers retain the established unused-style behavior.
contract.geometry: The selected consumer must be an ordinary open, uncut, unfilled MLINE with at least two vertices, positive finite scale, justification 1 or 2, unit extrusion, source-consistent WCS positions/directions/miters, and exactly two values per group-41 segment tuple with a zero second value. Group-42 fill parameter lists must be empty. The first group-41 value is recomputed from the target element offset, scale, justification shift, and signed miter intersection denominator. No caller-owned MLINE model is mutated.
contract.identityAndOutput: The projected copy retains the original redundant group-2 style name and changes only the authoritative group-340 target. The focused proof checks the output MLINESTYLE offsets, each actual MLINE group 340 reference and group 2 value, all group-41 parameters in BLOCKS and ENTITIES, then imports the result and verifies the target style binding, name, scales, extrusion, WCS vertices/directions/miters, segment parameters and empty fill arrays.
contract.failureAndRetry: A target with incompatible geometry flags refuses before publication and preserves a destination sentinel and caller state. A late live-consumer mutation after ENTITIES emission also refuses before publication; restoring the borrowed model permits a successful retry on the same adapter. The successful output is reopened for readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Existing ASCII/binary writer paths remain in place. Source and output DXF documents are generated at runtime by the regression and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
contract.limits: The regression covers AC1027 ASCII and binary sources crossed with ASCII and binary output, two equal-arity style elements, flags 2, equal start/end angles, one model-space MLINE and one named-block MLINE, three vertices, two extrusion planes, and justifications 1 and 2. It does not qualify group-71 count edits, different arity/flags/angles, non-offset geometry changes, cuts, closed MLINEs, fills, other versions/carriers, native CAD rendering, document closure, or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.styleAndConsumerProfile: The generated source has original style D and target style D2, both with flags 2, equal angles and equal two-element arity. The target style carries distinct non-geometry metadata. It exercises both a pre-existing offset difference (original 1.25/-0.75, target 1.5/-0.75) and a composed target-offset edit plus retarget from an equal-offset baseline. Both source-bound MLINE consumers are retargeted to D2 while their redundant group-2 name remains OLD_ENTITY_NAME.
controls.outputProof: Verify the old style remains at offsets 1.25/-0.75; the target style is at 1.5/-0.75; both MLINE group-340 values resolve to the emitted target style; group 2 remains OLD_ENTITY_NAME; and all twelve group-41 values per entity match the independently authored WCS/miter parameter calculation. Reimport and verify both consumers bind to the target style while preserving their redundant names and authored geometry.
controls.failureAndRetry: Eight successful source/output profiles and ten readbacks; two incompatible-target refusals preserve sentinels and caller state, then succeed on the same adapter after correcting target flags; two late-consumer-mutation refusals preserve sentinels, then succeed on the same adapter after restoring caller state.

selectedRegression.summary: 8 source/style/output profiles; 10 readbacks; 2 preflight refusals; 2 late-mutation refusals; 4 same-adapter retries

affectedMlineCohort.summary: 5/5: MLINESTYLE transactions, geometry guard, source/live guard, consumed-style offset projection, and geometry-changing retarget offset projection

next: Select one current still-refused P2 witness. Prefer a count-71 edit or a non-offset/earlier-version MLINE retarget only when its exact source and output expectation are already bounded. Keep other retarget profiles, carriers, schemas and semantic/platform claims open.
